question: Which dataset has been used in this work?

evidence: In this section we describe the experiments performed to demonstrate the validity of our proposed method and its extension. We used the Reuters-8 dataset without stop words from BIBREF27 aiming at single-label classification, which is a preprocessed format of the Reuters-21578. Words in the texts were considered as they appeared, without performing stemming or typo correction. This database has eight different classes with the number of samples varying from 51 to over 3000 documents, as can be seen in Table 1 .

answer.free_form_answer: The Reuters-8 dataset (with stop words removed)
